name: Apothecary Zinge
summary: Beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, Apothecary Zinge works for the Forsaken. She studies biological specimens and arranges research shipments across Horde lands.

sections.title: In Service to the Society
sections.body: Apothecary Zinge works in the Apothecarium beneath the Undercity. Under Master Apothecary Faranell, she searches for chemical and biological compounds that can advance the Forsaken's aims. Her work connects her with field researchers and scouts far beyond Tirisfal Glades, including at distant outposts in Kalimdor.

sections.title: Cross-Continental Experiments
sections.body: Apothecary Zinge depends on couriers and adventurers to carry test materials across the sea. She regularly writes to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in the Barrens. She sends him toxic wolf heart samples from Silverpine Forest so he can study how Lordaeron's toxins affect Kalimdor's beasts.

faq.q: Where can Apothecary Zinge be found?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge works in the Apothecarium, the alchemical quarter on the southeastern tier of the Undercity.

faq.q: What organization does she belong to?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society, a company of Forsaken alchemists who create concoctions, plagues, and antidotes in service to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why does she need samples from the Barrens?
faq.answer: The samples go from Silverpine Forest to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads. Zinge has adventurers carry toxic wolf hearts to her colleague, who studies how Lordaeron's toxins affect Kalimdor's beasts.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see researchers like Zinge at the forefront of your people's scientific independence. They work tirelessly on solutions meant to secure the Forsaken's survival and supremacy.
As Horde, you rely on open supply routes and trusted runners crossing the sea between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms to keep your front lines supplied.
